units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.motion: static (background identical between frames 0 and 72 outside the objects; stitched background gives near-zero difference everywhere else)
camera.layout: split view: above-water view (grey sky, sea surface) for y < 672.5, flat blue underwater view for y > 672.5
camera.perspective: side-on orthographic-looking 2D layout; no vanishing cues used. Boat and shark keep constant pixel size over the clip (boat length 854 +/- 1 px, shark area 9300-9600 px^2) so each moves at constant depth. They are in different panels (above / below water) and may be at different depths; one scale from the prior object is the default.

objects.name: boat
objects.description: red-hulled fishing boat with white wheelhouse, mast, rails, registration 'AH805' on the bow; only object in the upper (above-water) panel
objects.direction: +x (to the right), horizontal only (no vertical motion: hull/cabin top & bottom rows constant)
objects.notes: mast top always cut by top image border; bow passes the right border from frame 48; at frame 72 about 420 px (stern part) remains visible
objects.reference_point: ref_x = hull bounding-box centre (stern sub-pixel edge + 412.97 px); ref_y = 415.4 (fixed, centre of hull+cabin rows 231-599; boat has no vertical motion, true origin height unknown)

objects.name: shark
objects.description: grey shark (white belly, dorsal fin, forked tail) swimming in the lower blue underwater panel; only object there
objects.direction: -x (to the left), horizontal (centroid y 906 +/- 0.3 for frames 0-60)
objects.notes: nose reaches left border at frame 60; frames 61-72 only rear part / tail visible (at frame 72 only 44 px of tail). Tail beats, so tail-edge and centroid jitter about +/-1.5 px per frame.
objects.reference_point: frames 0-60: mask centroid (approx. body centre); frames 61-72: tail edge - 129.14 px (mean centroid-tail offset of frames 49-60), extrapolated off-screen

static_objects.name: sea_horizon
static_objects.description: boundary between grey sky and sea surface in upper panel

static_objects.name: underwater_panel_top
static_objects.description: top edge of the flat blue underwater area (cuts boat's submerged hull/reflection)

static_objects.name: sea_surface_band
static_objects.description: light purple-grey water surface band between horizon and panel top

events.event: both objects stationary between frames 0 and 1 (frame 1 identical position to frame 0)
motion start: first non-zero displacement, boat and shark
events.note: displacement from frame 1 to 2; boat jumps directly to its constant step (~17.9 px/frame), shark starts at ~7.5 px/frame and its steps grow steadily (~16.7-17.7 px/frame by frames 58-72)

events.event: boat bow touches right image border
shark nose touches left image border
boat and shark horizontal reference x coincide (cross each other, in different panels)
events.note: boat ref_x 748.5 (f6) -> 766.5 (f7); shark ref_x 757.2 (f6) -> 747.0 (f7); crossing between frames 6 and 7 (~t 0.27 s)

events.event: clip ends with both objects partly out of frame

measurement_reliability.boat_ref_x: +/-0.1 px per frame (sub-pixel stern edge averaged over 11 rows); offset to true origin unknown but constant
measurement_reliability.shark_ref_x: +/-1.5 px per frame (body flex); frames 61-72 extrapolated from tail edge, +/-3 px
